bookTitle: SGA 2 — Cohomologie locale des faisceaux cohérents et théorèmes de Lefschetz locaux et globaux

origin.note: Advanced Studies in Pure Mathematics 2, North-Holland, Amsterdam, 1968 (séminaire 1962). Internet Archive scan with an OCR text layer. Split with qpdf --pages (object-level copy); no page was re-rendered or recompressed.
origin.layout: 2-up: each of the 148 landscape sheets holds two consecutive book pages. From sheet 6 onward, sheet s holds book pages (2s-10, 2s-9); book p. 1 is the right half of sheet 5. pdfPages below count sheets of ../sga2.pdf.

pageOffset.note: Book page p → sheet (p+10)/2 for even p (left half), (p+9)/2 for odd p (right half). A sheet carrying the boundary between two parts is included in both files; the shared sheets are 5, 14, 18, 26, 35, 43, 54, 60, 106, 147.

entries.note: Series/title pages (sheet 1), imprint and editorial note (sheet 2), Table des matières (sheets 3–5 left). Sheet 5 shared with Introduction.pdf.

entries.title: Introduction
entries.note: Starts on the right half of sheet 5 (shared with frontmatter.pdf).
